_meta.title: Black Crypt (Amiga) world rules, area 4
_meta.addresses: S_1 = decompressed bcdft S_1 offsets; A4 = S_2+0x7FFE; char records at A4+0x1758 stride 0xA8; object records at A4-0x6E7A + unique*0x14
_meta.grades: code = read from disassembly (S_1 offset given); hypothesis = inferred, not code-proven; open = not derived

0x16.name: inventory grid 3 rows x 6 words, index = 0x16 + row*0xC + col*2

0x62.name: AC current (printed in LV/AC panel)
0x62.grade: code for arithmetic, hypothesis for label 'AC' (panel print +0x14C34)

0x63.name: AC copy kept in lockstep with +0x62

0x64..0x6d.name: 10 current stat bytes. idx0..4 = attribute stats (idx3 +0x67 resists disease via T1; idx4 +0x68 gives base AC via T1, pit damage, and is cut by TIRED); idx5..9 = +0x69..+0x6d protection-type stats
0x64..0x6d.grade: code for roles, hypothesis for names

0x6e..0x77.name: 10 max stat bytes (copy source at reset). maxSTR = +0x6e (carry limit)

0xa4.name: carried weight (sum of item word+8, recursive through containers)

0x82.grade: code for item mapping/AC, hypothesis for label (status icon string S_1+0x1A89E 'SHIELD')

0x83.meaning: MAGIC SHIELD: halves monster special-attack landing (rand(100)<=50)

0x85.meaning: status icon 4 (party total $1E2A, redraw on change)

0x87.grade: code (case 0xD of +0x98A8; icon shows GAZE PROTECTION)

0x8b.effect: 0x1d (no equip case; set only by effects)

0x8f.meaning: POSSESSION PROTECTION (monster case 0xC skips chars with it)

adjust_vitals_calls._note: S_1+0x17EEA AdjustVitals(char, dEnergy, dFood, dWater); only acts if HP>0

tired_penalty: on crossing energy 1000 downward: STR(+0x64) -1, DEX-like(+0x68) -1 and AC re-based; on crossing upward: both +1

item_record.0x04: pos nibble (high) | class mask (low nibble 1 Fighter,2 Cleric,4 Druid,8 MU)
item_record.0x07: charges (0xFF = infinite; 0 = ITEM IS OUT OF CHARGES)
item_record.0x0C: AC (armour types, low byte) / extraDamage / maxCharges / lockNumber (keys) / contained-child unique (containers) / slot code row*10+col (type 0x0D)
item_record.0x0E: effect code word (0x00-0x09 stat idx, 0x14-0x22 counters, 0x80-0x9F use-effects)
item_record.grade: code (+0x18088, +0xECF0, +0x12FEA, +0x11992); +0x0A=size from doc, only +0x08 consumed by weight

slot_type_table_S2_0x0000._note: 3 rows x 6 cols, byte = allowed item type; 0xFE = any/hand; 0xFF = no equip-effect slot (pack); 0x2A = two-wide bracers
slot_type_table_S2_0x0000.grade: code (+0x18088/+0xE56A read A4-0x7FFE+col+row*6), row/col naming hypothesis

equip_effect_rules.ac_source: low byte of item word +0x0C added to +0x62 and +0x63
equip_effect_rules.type_0x0D: slot-bound: effect only when word+0xC == row*10+col
equip_effect_rules.effect_4: stat[0x68] += value with AC base re-derived through T1

use_effects_0x80_0x9f._fn: S_1+0x12FEA UseItem(char,itemUnique); blocked on squares with flag bit6 (SPELL FAILED); 0x95 = random 0x80+rand(10); effects 0x96-0xA9 (except 0x9E) also play a spell visual; after use charge-- unless 0xFF; active char energy -1

0x8a.meaning: party full food and water (5000/5000) for all living chars

0x97.meaning: INVINCIBLE: +0x8c++, expires via event type 0x1E at now+900 ticks (a2=10)

0x9c.meaning: potion of strength: STR current +2 (refund logic via +0x84A0C), reverts through event type 0x1F at now+1800

tablet_type_0x30._fn: S_1+0x16502; readerClass byte +7 must equal the clicked character INDEX

effects.5: level up: XP += 1<<(level+7), level++, HP/maxHP += T1[stat+0x67]+rand+7
effects.10-13: transform the tablet into template record 0-3

glyph_0x10_subkind3._fn: S_1+0x4662; record word +0x10 = glyph type, +0x0E = magnitude m
glyph_0x10_subkind3.type1_m_nonzero: dmg = -1+rand(0) = 0xFFFF -> kills every char with HP>1
glyph_0x10_subkind3.type2_3: dmg = 5 + rand(5*m) per char with HP>1 (damage type 4)
glyph_0x10_subkind3.type4: per char with HP>1 and no +0x8b: +0x9a++, dmg = rand(10)+1 (damage type 5)

pit_fall.rule: each char HP>0 and +0x8a==0 takes 5 + rand(n), n = DEXstat>15 ? DEXstat-10 : DEXstat+5 (stat byte +0x68), damage type 4

trap_actions.0x1C: fire: 5 + rand(5*v) to each char HP>1

party_held: $1756 ticks decremented in tick handler (+0x902); while >0 click handler (+0xD6D8) ignores action clicks except a few ids (0x8/0x9/0x5B in dungeon mode, 0x45)

monster_status_attacks_0x98A8.0x0E: disease +0x97++, dmg rand(6)+1, needs +0x88==0 and rand+20-T1[+0x67]>30
monster_status_attacks_0x98A8.gate: rand(100)>= +0x69 style roll then +0x83 magic shield 50%

key_lock.rule: key type 0x06 word+0x0C == lock (type 0x22) word+0x0C and lock word+0x0E != 0; key consumed; lock counter--, opens when 0

fields.0x0E: max monsters in scan neighbourhood before it stops

monster_generator.fn: scan S_1+0xB614 (+-3 squares), spawn BAA6; also scripted action 0x12
monster_generator.grade: code for fields/flow, hypothesis for meanings of 0x0E

shops: none (no BUY/SELL/PRICE/GOLD-currency strings; GOLD appears only in key names)

rest.flag: $1746 = 1 while some asleep, 2 when all asleep (tick regen branch)
